proof_body:
by
  intro x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x y hne
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hx : x₂ - x₁ = 0
    · have hy : y₂ - y₁ ≠ 0 := by
        intro hy
        exact hne ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      refine ⟨(y - y₁) / (y₂ - y₁), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hxx : (y₂ - y₁) * (x - x₁) = 0 := by rw [← h, hx]; ring
        have : x - x₁ = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hxx).resolve_left hy
        rw [hx]; linarith
      · field_simp; ring
    · refine ⟨(x - x₁) / (x₂ - x₁), ?_, ?_⟩
      · field_simp; ring
      · field_simp
        linear_combination h
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩
    ring
target_source: ∀ (x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x y : ℝ), ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂) → ((x₂ - x₁) * (y - y₁) = (y₂ - y₁) * (x - x₁) ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, x = x₁ + t * (x₂ - x₁) ∧ y = y₁ + t * (y₂ - y₁))
